noncomputable def modalOperator (lam damping e11 e12 e21 e22 : ℝ) : State →L[ℝ] State :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap {
    toFun := fun z => !₂[(lam - damping + e11) * z 0 + e12 * z 1,
      e21 * z 0 + (-lam - damping + e22) * z 1]
    map_add' := by
      intro x y
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp <;> ring
    map_smul' := by
      intro c x
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp <;> ring }
